title: Watercolor Parkside | KEY.co
description_expanded: Overlooking the lush beauty of Cerulean Park in the coveted Phase I of WaterColor, this exceptional coastal retreat offers an extraordinary blend of elegance, comfort, and location. One of only a select few homes positioned along this picturesque park, the six-bedroom residence provides over 4,400 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space along with expansive balconies and breezy porches. Warm details such as wide-plank pine floors, refined coastal finishes, and sun-filled gathering spaces create an atmosphere that feels both luxurious and welcoming. Just steps from Western Lake, a short stroll to the WaterColor Beach Club, and minutes from the charming shops and dining of Seaside, the home places the best of Scenic Highway 30A effortlessly within reach. Designed for unforgettable gatherings, the home comfortably sleeps up to 14 guests with multiple private suites, a charming carriage house, and a loft-style media retreat perfect for kids or teens. The chef’s kitchen, spacious living areas, and wraparound balcony invite effortless entertaining, while the private courtyard with pool provides a peaceful escape after a day at the beach. Guests can explore the community on the included six-seater golf cart or bikes and enjoy access to WaterColor’s celebrated amenities, including the Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, scenic trails, and waterfront adventures on Western Lake. With its rare park-front setting and beautifully curated spaces, this residence offers an inspiring setting for creating lasting coastal memories.

Features: Guests assume all risk for use of pools
